zh: 新增可自托管的 Web 版、宽屏布局和共享文件夹同步。
训练支持次数区间、动作间与左右侧休息、复制动作及独立距离单位。
热身组不再计入力量纪录和训练量，CSV 导出增加组类型与 RIR；修复步数统计与部分 Mali GPU 显示。
en: Added a self-hosted web app, desktop layouts, and shared-folder sync.
Added rep ranges, rest between exercises and sides, exercise duplication, and per-exercise distance units.
Excluded warm-up sets from strength records and working volume; CSV includes set type and RIR. Fixed step totals and rendering on some Mali GPUs.

zh: 饮食测试版支持粘贴 AI 生成的餐单，补剂可记录剂量与库存。
新增轻量训练、左右侧次数，以及按次数查看重量纪录。
改进训练方案编辑、历史记录录入与耳机计时提示。
en: Paste AI-generated meals into the nutrition beta and track supplement doses and stock.
Log light sessions and left/right reps, and see weight records by rep count.
Improved routine editing, past workout entry, and headphone-only timer sounds.

zh: 个人资料下拉可查看训练月报，并分享月度卡片。
新增自动进阶、减量周和保留连练的休息日。
加入休息语音提示测试版、自定义通知铃声和性能模式。
en: Pull down on your profile for a monthly recap and shareable cards.
Added automatic progression, deload weeks, and days off that preserve your streak.
Added beta rest voice cues, custom notification sounds, and performance modes.

zh: 新增计时循环训练、逐组备注和运动项目记录。
记录睡眠与精力，支持按日期范围导出报告，并可将训练写入 Health Connect。
en: Added timed circuits, per-set notes, and sport logging.
Added sleep and energy check-ins, date-range reports, and workout export to Health Connect.

zh: 新增 Health Connect 健康页、训练纪录奖杯和健身房通行证。
动作可独立选择公斤或磅，轮换可安排休息日，并支持自定义进阶。
en: Added a Health Connect view, in-workout record trophies, and a gym pass.
Choose kg or lb per exercise, add rest days to rotations, and customize progression.

zh: 新增文件夹自动备份、保存周计划和归档训练方案。
可为单个动作配置进阶规则，支持簇组及有氧热量记录。
en: Added automatic folder backups, saved weekly plans, and routine archiving.
Added per-exercise progression rules, cluster sets, and cardio calorie logging.
